title: How to contact Elizabeth
text:
First: please just call me Elizabeth, no need to address me formally as “Dr. Pankratz” or anything like that :)
You can email me at elizabeth.pankratz (at) ed.ac.uk.
If you do, please include “Minidiss” in the email subject line so I know what you’re writing about! I’ll almost always respond within a day or two of receiving your message :)
If you want to know more about my background and research interests, here’s my website.
